_comment: S1 SMOKE — 10 epochs of the _spectro_50sta_3h posture (staged cadence: a 10-epoch
smoke before any >= 1 h arm; docs/SPEC_lane_spectrometer.md §3.5 / §11).
This is NOT a verdict run.  It answers four mechanical questions before 3.5 h of
wall clock is spent, each of which has silently wasted a run before:
1. does logs/network_phase_anchor.csv appear AND carry a varying anchor_sta?  Under
the eq34 chain datum a satellite is pinned at EVERY station incident to it in the
spanning tree (~3.9 stations per (sat,signal) measured at 50 sta / 17 sats), so
the file is a pin SET, not a single anchor per satellite — the grader takes the
modal station per arc and reports churn separately.  A constant column would mean
the legacy single-pivot datum is in force and the partition degenerates.
2. what does the uncapped DD-frac pool actually measure per epoch at 50 stations?
Read the 'DD-frac tracer' log line's DD count: if it approaches 2000 the cap is
about to bind and the arc continuity the ladder needs starts dying as p^4.
3. is the SD EWL row layer alive at all (sd_ewl armed here with the DIAGNOSTIC
min_arc_epochs 2 so arcs mature inside 10 epochs), and does the integer decision
produce non-zero dd_fixed?  Read the two run-end 'Network (SD EWL integer fix)'
lines: rows_fixed == 0 with a named dominant cause is the answer to look for.
4. does the grader run end-to-end on a 10-epoch trace without a join collapse?
sd_ewl + fix_enable are armed HERE ONLY.  The 3.5 h S1 seed deliberately leaves them
OFF: S1 grades the producer as it is, and folding rows would change the DDs it grades.
The integer path is exercised here purely so a miswire is found in 10 epochs.
sigma_floor_m 1.0 / max_abs_z_m 10.0 are the increment-1 MEASURED honest ladder — the
unguarded 0.05 m floor over-weights by ~13x (SPEC_sd_ewl_prereduce §7.4).
